target.title: chore: automate design system updates
target.body:
## Summary

- run Dependabot daily for all configured ecosystems
- check the latest `openclaw/design-system` release daily and on demand
- reinstall the five released OpenClaw design skills at full depth
- update one stable automation PR only when the installed release changes

## Validation

- `actionlint .github/workflows/update-design-system-skills.yml`
- local workflow simulation: first run updated only the skill lock; second run was a no-op
- `git diff --check`

## Current limitation

`openclaw/design-system` is private. The workflow is structurally ready, but GitHub-hosted runs in this consumer repository cannot read the private cross-repository release with the default `GITHUB_TOKEN`. Keep this PR in draft until the design-system repository is public or a read credential is configured.

Part of CLAW-484.
